name: openrouter-mcp
description: Discover OpenRouter models and generate images, video, speech, and music, transcribe audio, embed and rerank text, ask decision models typed questions, and describe images from Claude.
long_description: A single Rust binary that exposes OpenRouter to Claude over MCP. Discover models with their capabilities and pricing (server-side filters for category, provider, price, region, benchmarks), generate and edit images (with parallel seed-stepped variants and a sidecar manifest), generate video (text-to-video / image-to-video with audio and video references, async with poll-by-task_id), generate speech (text-to-speech, including stateless voice cloning), generate music (Google Lyria 3 via streamed audio output, with the per-track cost reported), transcribe audio (with provider options such as speaker diarization), embed text and rerank documents, ask a decisions model (TypeSafe Jev) typed true/false, choice and score questions about a state and get calibrated probabilities back, describe images (path/url/base64) with a vision model, send a prompt with images, files, audio or video to any chat/text model (structured JSON output, web search, provider routing), look up the cost record of any request by its generation id, and track per-process usage. Every generation tool takes a `provider` object for routing and per-provider passthrough options. Bring your own OpenRouter API key.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List available OpenRouter models with capabilities and pricing; filter server-side by modality, category, provider, author, price, region, zdr, age and benchmark index, sort, and page with limit/offset.

tools.name: describe_model
tools.description: Get the full detail for a single model by id: description, architecture, context, benchmarks, and per-provider endpoints (pricing, uptime, supported parameters, allowed_passthrough_parameters for provider options).

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate or edit an image with an OpenRouter image model and save it to disk (parallel variants; input images by path, url, or base64/data-URL; size as WIDTHxHEIGHT or aspect_ratio + image_size; provider routing and per-provider options).

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Generate a video from a prompt (text-to-video), from first/last frames (image-to-video, prompt optional), or from reference images/audio/video with an OpenRouter video model; upscaling and per-provider options; runs async, poll get_result by task_id.

tools.name: generate_audio
tools.description: Generate speech (text-to-speech) from text with an OpenRouter TTS model and save it to disk; voice is provider-dependent and optional, voice cloning via a reference sample, per-provider options.

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Generate music from a text prompt with an OpenRouter music model (Google Lyria 3) and save the track to disk; synchronous, reports the per-track cost; optional provider routing.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe speech to text (speech-to-text) from a local audio file or inline base64 with an OpenRouter STT model; per-provider options such as speaker diarization.

tools.name: chat_completion
tools.description: Send a prompt to any OpenRouter chat/text model and return its text reply; useful to route a sub-task to a different model. Attach images, files (PDF), audio or video for a multimodal model; sampling controls, JSON schema / JSON mode output, web search, reasoning controls, provider routing.

tools.name: embed_text
tools.description: Embed one or more texts with an OpenRouter embeddings model and return the float vectors with usage and cost.

tools.name: rerank_documents
tools.description: Rerank candidate documents against a query with an OpenRouter rerank model; returns them best-first with relevance scores.

tools.name: make_decisions
tools.description: Ask an OpenRouter decisions model (TypeSafe Jev) typed noul/choice/score questions about a state and get calibrated probabilities back; synchronous, via /api/alpha/decisions; optional provider routing.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Look up OpenRouter's stored record of one request by its generation_id: actual cost, provider, native token counts, latency.

tools.name: get_result
tools.description: Fetch the status and result of a generation job by task_id.

tools.name: describe_image
tools.description: Describe or answer questions about image(s) (by path, url, or base64/data-URL) with a vision-capable model; optional system, temperature, max_tokens, reasoning effort and provider routing.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Return info about the OpenRouter API key in use: label, credit usage, limits, and tier.

tools.name: get_usage_stats
tools.description: Return in-memory usage statistics for this server process.

tools.name: reset_usage_stats
tools.description: Reset all in-memory usage statistics to zero (requires confirm=true).

api_key.title: OpenRouter API Key
api_key.description: Your OpenRouter API key. Create one at https://openrouter.ai/keys
